sql: select * from "learning_v2_attempts" where "id" = $1 and "user_id" = $2 for update

select case resource.kind
      when 'topic' then exists(select 1 from content_items item where item.id=resource.id
        and item.kind='topic' and item.status='published' and item.catalog_visibility='catalog')
      when 'source' then exists(select 1 from learning_resource_revisions revision
        join learning_resources source on source.id=revision.resource_id
        join content_items item on item.id=source.source_content_id
        where revision.id=resource.id and source.retired_at is null
          and item.status='published' and item.catalog_visibility='catalog')
      when 'asset' then exists(select 1 from content_assets asset
        join content_items item on item.id=asset.content_item_id
        where asset.id=resource.id and asset.status='ready'
          and item.status='published' and item.catalog_visibility='catalog')
      else false end as available
    from unnest($1::text[], $2::uuid[]) as resource(kind,id)
select count(*) as "count" from "learning_mutation_receipts" where "user_id" = $1 and "created_at" > $2 and response_json->>'rateLimitV2' = $3

insert into "learning_mutation_receipts" ("user_id", "idempotency_key", "request_hash", "response_json", "http_status") values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) on conflict ("user_id", "idempotency_key") do nothing returning "idempotency_key"
select * from "learning_v2_attempts" where "id" = $1 and "user_id" = $2 for update

select case resource.kind
      when 'topic' then exists(select 1 from content_items item where item.id=resource.id
        and item.kind='topic' and item.status='published' and item.catalog_visibility='catalog')
      when 'source' then exists(select 1 from learning_resource_revisions revision
        join learning_resources source on source.id=revision.resource_id
        join content_items item on item.id=source.source_content_id
        where revision.id=resource.id and source.retired_at is null
          and item.status='published' and item.catalog_visibility='catalog')
      when 'asset' then exists(select 1 from content_assets asset
        join content_items item on item.id=asset.content_item_id
        where asset.id=resource.id and asset.status='ready'
          and item.status='published' and item.catalog_visibility='catalog')
      else false end as available
    from unnest($1::text[], $2::uuid[]) as resource(kind,id)
update "learning_v2_attempts" set "resume_json" = $1, "row_version" = row_version + 1, "updated_at" = $2 where "id" = $3 and "row_version" = $4 returning *

insert into "learning_v2_activity_state" ("enrollment_id", "user_id", "path_version_id", "activity_key", "state", "evidence_attempt_id") values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) on conflict ("enrollment_id", "path_version_id", "activity_key") do update set "state" = $7, "evidence_attempt_id" = $8, "row_version" = learning_v2_activity_state.row_version + 1, "updated_at" = $9

select
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(fact) order by fact.created_at) from learning_v2_attempts fact
      where fact.user_id=$1::uuid and fact.enrollment_id=$2::uuid
        and fact.path_version_id=any($3::uuid[])), '[]'::jsonb) as attempts,
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(fact)) from learning_v2_responses fact
      where fact.user_id=$4::uuid and fact.enrollment_id=$5::uuid
        and fact.path_version_id=any($6::uuid[])), '[]'::jsonb) as responses,
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(event) order by event.occurred_at,event.id) from
      (select id,user_id,enrollment_id,event_type,semantic_key,occurred_at,policy_version,payload_json
        from learning_events where user_id=$7::uuid and enrollment_id=$8::uuid
          and policy_version='guided-v2.0') event), '[]'::jsonb) as events
select * from "learning_v2_review_state" where "user_id" = $1 and "path_version_id" = $2 order by "objective_key" for update
select "objective_key" from "learning_v2_review_state" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "path_version_id" = $3 and "due_at" <= $4

select stored.objective_key as "objectiveKey",
      (stored.evidence_json is not distinct from expected.evidence_json
        and stored.error_json is not distinct from expected.error_json
        and date_trunc('milliseconds',stored.first_mastered_at) is not distinct from expected.first_mastered_at
        and date_trunc('milliseconds',stored.first_consolidated_at) is not distinct from expected.first_consolidated_at) as unchanged
    from learning_v2_objective_state stored
    left join jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as expected(objective_key text,
      evidence_json jsonb,error_json jsonb,first_mastered_at timestamptz,first_consolidated_at timestamptz)
      on expected.objective_key=stored.objective_key
    where stored.user_id=$2::uuid and stored.enrollment_id=$3::uuid and stored.path_version_id=$4::uuid
    order by stored.objective_key for update of stored

select "learning_enrollment_versions"."path_version_id", "learning_enrollment_versions"."previous_version_id", "learning_enrollment_versions"."adopted_at", "learning_enrollment_versions"."mapping_json", "learning_path_versions"."version_number", "learning_path_versions"."policy_version" from "learning_enrollment_versions" inner join "learning_path_versions" on "learning_path_versions"."id" = "learning_enrollment_versions"."path_version_id" where "learning_enrollment_versions"."enrollment_id" = $1 order by "learning_path_versions"."version_number"
